marking: minimal prefix descending eta_K_squared, ties ascending element ID; no reference access
mark_to_intervals: each marked cell bisects its longer original physical interval; equal lengths select X; deduplicate selected intervals; add global coordinate lines at midpoints
quality_closure: while max(max(dx)/min(dy),max(dy)/min(dx))>4 bisect largest offending interval; equal-length ties X then lower index; all added lines count
over_budget_action: reject entire proposal before solve and stop adaptive branch; never drop marks or change theta
recovery: area-weighted affine least squares at nodes, local normalized coordinates, expand shared-vertex element rings until rank3 and condition<=1e8; no constant fallback
indicator: integral (Nstar-Nh)^T Ainv (Nstar-Nh)+(Mstar-Mh)^T Dinv (Mstar-Mh)+(Qstar-Qh)^T Sinv (Qstar-Qh); unsmoothed native centroid Nh/Mh/Qh constant per cell
basis: native ESYS=0, default KEYOPT11=0 verified; rect I-J along +X, first parametric tangent +X, normal +Z; explicit tensor rotation
shear: native section PROP,E and Q/gamma cross-check; single isotropic layer documented automatic stiffness (5/6)Gt only with explicit verified section/default evidence
reference_role: h=3.125 saved P1 linear only for error assessment; never marking or recovery or observation
time_accounting: one shared start solve and common export/recovery/graph workflow charged in full to each standalone method; adaptive adds marking/remesh/rejections; uniform includes common start then new h25; actual shared work not summed twice; development and artifact verification separate; each method receives same session-launch charge and measured final close charge; physical per-stage and end-to-end wall times retained
uniform_indicator: computed and exported with the same diagnostic workflow for comparable postprocessing, not used to refine uniform grid
stop: three adaptive solves or next complete proposal over budget or required validation failure; report both accuracy goals independently at every completed level
